title: Keyboard Partita No. 2 in C minor: Sinfonia
movement: I. Sinfonia (Grave – Andante – Allegro); Allemande also in the score files
video_use_ideas: Grave dotted opening to a fugal sprint: a three-act story arc in two minutes.
legal_notes: Composition PD worldwide (J. S. Bach d.1750). Mutopia piece 602 ('Six Partitas (Clavierubung part I): No. 2', for Harpsichord, Piano, Clavichord); licence shown as Public Domain on the piece page, in the Mutopia RDF and in the .ly header (placed in the public domain by typesetter Carl Bolstad). Edition source: Bach-Gesellschaft. Mutopia has only the Sinfonia and Allemande of this partita. Preview is an own FluidSynth (FluidR3_GM) render of the Mutopia MIDI, not a human performance; no recording in this row.
licence_meaning: PD / CC0 / PDM / US-gov recording and score. Commercial use, no credit needed (courtesy credit still listed where the source asks).
